name: codebase-learning
description: A comprehensive plugin for learning codebase structure, architecture, design patterns, and domain concepts through specialized agents and interactive commands
author: Jsnn

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Interactive learning command - choose what aspect of the codebase to explore

commands.name: learn-architecture
commands.description: Analyze system architecture, layers, modules, and design decisions

commands.name: learn-flow
commands.description: Trace code execution paths for specific features end-to-end

commands.name: learn-patterns
commands.description: Identify design patterns, architectural patterns, and coding conventions

commands.name: learn-concepts
commands.description: Explain domain concepts and how they're implemented in code

agents.name: architecture-analyzer
agents.description: Deep analysis of system architecture, layer separation, and design decisions

agents.name: code-flow-tracer
agents.description: Traces execution paths and explains feature implementation end-to-end

agents.name: pattern-detector
agents.description: Identifies design patterns, architectural patterns, and coding conventions

agents.name: concept-explainer
agents.description: Explains complex domain concepts and their code implementations
